name: "Shounen A" no Ijou na Aijou -Soshite Watashi wa Naze Gekiyaku wo Aishita ka-
original_name: 『少年A』の異常な愛情-そして私は何故劇薬を愛したか-
source:
The Abnormal Love of “Boy A” - And Why I Woke Up a Pitch-White Girl

I was locked up by a pitch-black boy.

The pitch-black boy's name is “Boy A”.

Boy A said, "I locked you up because I love you."


The white girl doesn't know who she is.

She doesn't even know who “Boy A” is.

Everything is a mystery, and all she can think is...

[i]"Let me out of here."[/i]

That's all she can think about.

　
　　What awaits her after her escape from captivity?

　　What awaits her beyond captivity?

　　What awaits her beyond her nostalgia?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11568]Novelgame[/url].]
